name: signal.performance
description: Classify a published item's result so 'what is working' becomes a counted claim instead of a vibe.

outcome.instructions: What did this item actually produce

criteria.business_outcome: A reply, booked call, lead, or revenue event
criteria.audience_signal: Meaningful saves, shares, or substantive comments but no business event
criteria.vanity_only: Impressions or likes with no substantive engagement

attributable.instructions: The result can be attributed to this item specifically rather than to coincident activity

repeatable_format.instructions: The format, not the topic, is what appears to have driven the result

sample_too_small.instructions: The sample is too small to support a conclusion about what works

rules.reason: sample too small -- do not turn this into a rule
not cleanly attributable; label as correlation
real business outcome -- study this format deliberately
